info.title: Healthy Eating API
info.description:
REST API of a self-hosted Healthy Eating server, used by the iOS app.

Authenticate with an access token from the server's OAuth 2.1 flow. Errors use one format:
`{"code", "message", "details"}`. Dates are the user's local days (YYYY-MM-DD); times are
ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Energy is in kcal, macronutrients and portions in grams.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Active sign-ins of this client, oldest first

status.title: Status
status.description: 'complete': every meal of the day is logged; 'partial': some are missing

estimated_calories_share.title: Estimated Calories Share
estimated_calories_share.description: Share of the day's calories the assistant estimated (0 to 1); null without calories

status.title: Status
status.description: Completeness mark; null if the day is not marked

counted.title: Counted
counted.description: Whether the day counts for averages (see counting_rule)

days.title: Days
days.description: Every local day of the range, oldest first

counting_rule.title: Counting Rule
counting_rule.description: 'complete_days': only days marked complete count (the user has marked one); 'logged_days': every day with meals counts except days marked partial. Days without meals never count.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be 'delete-account', so an account is never deleted by accident

code.title: Code
code.description: Machine-readable: bad_request, unauthorized, forbidden, not_found, conflict, invalid_request or error

last_used_at.title: Last Used At
last_used_at.description: Last use, recorded at most once a minute

current.title: Current
current.description: True for the sign-in making this request

last_meal_saved_at.title: Last Meal Saved At
last_meal_saved_at.description: When the latest meal reached Healthy Eating (not when it was eaten)

last_client_name.title: Last Client Name
last_client_name.description: The AI assistant that saved it, if known

meals_today.title: Meals Today
meals_today.description: Meals eaten on the user's local today

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page

eaten_at.title: Eaten At
eaten_at.description: When the meal was eaten, in its local time with the UTC offset: the offset the user gave, or the one of their time zone

local_date.title: Local Date
local_date.description: The user's local day the meal counts for

source.title: Source
source.description: 'from_conversation': values came from the user's own workflow; 'estimated_by_assistant': the assistant estimated them

estimated_fields.title: Estimated Fields
estimated_fields.description: Values the assistant estimated rather than took from the user's workflow

client_name.title: Client Name
client_name.description: The AI assistant that saved the meal, if known

eaten_at.title: Eaten At
eaten_at.description: ISO 8601; without an offset it is read in the user's time zone

MealUpdate.title: MealUpdate
MealUpdate.description:
Only the fields present are changed; only portion_grams may be null (removes it).

Changed nutrition values become the user's own and lose their "estimated" mark.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Possible problems with the values, e.g. calories that do not match the macros

counted_days.title: Counted Days
counted_days.description: Days the averages are taken over

logged_days.title: Logged Days
logged_days.description: Days with at least one meal, counted or not

averages.description: Average per counted day; null if none counts

estimated_calories_share.title: Estimated Calories Share
estimated_calories_share.description: Share of the counted days' calories the assistant estimated (0 to 1)

signed_out.title: Signed Out
signed_out.description: True if this was the sign-in making the request: its tokens no longer work, so the app is signed out

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'; null if unknown

energy_unit.title: Energy Unit
energy_unit.description: Unit to show energy in; values stay in kcal

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Only the fields present are changed. null clears the time zone or a target.

TargetRangeModel.title: TargetRangeModel
TargetRangeModel.description: A daily target range. Either bound may be open (null), never both.

Targets.title: Targets
Targets.description: Daily targets in canonical units; null means no target.

current.description: The window ending today; today counts only once marked complete

previous.description: The window of the same length before it

change.description: current minus previous averages; null unless both have counted days

BearerAuth.description: Access token from this server's OAuth 2.1 flow (/authorize with PKCE, then /token). The same tokens work for the MCP endpoint.
